notablePrerequisites:
Prize Pig does not have summoning sickness.
You had an Angel and/or a Berserker enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
description:
Activate Prize Pig by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Peace of Mind by paying {W} and discarding Cleaving Reaper, causing you to gain three life.
Prize Pig triggers, putting three ribbon counters on it, then removing all ribbon counters on it and untapping it.
Activate Cleaving Reaper by paying three life, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
